name: hl2_357
stats_provenance: Half-Life 2's .357 Magnum as documented publicly: 6-round cylinder, 12 spare, about 0.75 s between shots, 40 damage against the pistol's 5. Relative to Halo's pistol: slower, harder hitting and tighter -- the 1.6 and 0.8 are ours.
view_model_mirrored_provenance: Half-Life 2 view models are authored right-handed.
world_grip_provenance: HL2's w_357 is a pickup with no weapon bone. It lies on its side (barrel +Y, grip +X, flat in Z) where a CS:S or GMod weapon bone expects barrel -Y and up +Z, so the grip is that turn, placed 1.5 units down the grip. Ours, checked by render.
crosshair_and_reload_provenance: HL2 .357 reload: its view model's reload clip, 3.7 s. Crosshair size ours.
